product.name: Invoica
product.one_line_purpose: Programmable invoicing for AI agents — issue, settle, and reconcile invoices on stablecoin rails.

entry_points.purpose: Issue a new invoice to a payer DID with line items and tax.
Settle an open invoice via x402 / PayAI / DRS receipt minting.
Look up a BOND recurring mandate by ID or payer DID.
Full pricing matrix for invoicing + settlement + tax calculation.
SCORE, partnerships, DRS receipt history, and constitutional binding.

pricing_summary: Free to issue. 0.01 USDC per settlement. Tax calc free up to 1k/day, then 0.001 USDC/call.
